name: Toyota Corolla AE86 (Levin / Trueno)
h1: Toyota Corolla AE86 (Levin / Sprinter Trueno): specs, 4A-GE engine and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA files every Corolla under COROLLA, front-drive sedans, hatchbacks and wagons included, so these counts cover all 1984–1987 Corollas, not just the rear-drive AE86 coupe and liftback.

us.x: Sold new in the US as the rear-drive Corolla Sport coupe and liftback for model years 1984 to 1987. The SR5 had the single-cam 4A-C from the start. The twin-cam GT-S, the US version of the Levin and Trueno, arrived for the 1985 model year. Japan built the AE86 from May 1983 to July 1987.

fame.x: In the Initial D manga (1995–2013) and anime, Takumi Fujiwara drives his father’s AE86 Sprinter Trueno GT-APEX on early-morning tofu deliveries, then races it on mountain passes. The series kept the car famous with a new generation of fans.

Keiichi Tsuchiya learned car control on Japan’s mountain passes in an AE86 Sprinter Trueno and became known as the Drift King. He helped turn drifting into a real motorsport and was a consultant on Initial D. In 2002, Katsuhiro Ueo won the D1 Grand Prix title in an AE86.
Chris Hodgetts won the British Saloon Car Championship in an AE86 in 1986 and again in 1987. The AE86 also won the 1986 European Touring Car Championship manufacturers’ title in its class.
Toyota says the 86 and GR86 are named in tribute to the AE86, called the hachi-roku (8-6) in Japan and the Corolla GT-S in the US.

related.t: Toyota GR86, named after the AE86

gens.tag: 1.6-liter 4A-GE twin-cam, 112 hp in the US GT-S (130 PS in Japan), 5-speed manual, rear-drive. Built in Japan May 1983 to July 1987.

variants.name: Corolla GT-S (US)

trans.note: limited-slip differential was an option on twin-cam manual cars

weight.note: Ate Up With Motor; Wikipedia lists about 2,200–2,300 lb for the US GT-S and SR5

variants.what: The US twin-cam car. Its 4A-GE used an airflow meter instead of Japan’s pressure-sensor injection, and it was rated 112 hp against 130 PS in Japan.

variants.name: Levin / Sprinter Trueno GT-APEX (Japan)

trans.note: a 4-speed automatic was added in May 1985; limited-slip differential optional

weight.note: Trueno GT-APEX, JDM; JDM Buy Sell lists 960 kg for a Levin GT-APEX three-door

variants.what: Japan’s top trim, sold as the Corolla Levin (fixed headlights) or Sprinter Trueno (pop-up headlights), as a 2-door coupe or 3-door liftback. Takumi’s car in Initial D is a Trueno GT-APEX.

variants.name: Corolla GT (UK)
variants.what: The European twin-cam car, sold in the UK and Ireland as a liftback only. evo quotes 0-62 mph in 8.3 seconds.

variants.name: Corolla SR5 (US)

hp.note: SAE net at launch; 74 hp from 1986, per Ate Up With Motor (Wikipedia’s year split differs)

tq.note: lb-ft early cars; 86 lb-ft at 2,800 rpm later

variants.what: The same rear-drive coupe and liftback with a carbureted single-cam, 8-valve 4A-C instead of the twin-cam. The GT-S cost about $1,200 to $1,300 more.

4A-GE.name: Toyota 4A-GE
facts: Inline-4, DOHC 16-valve, cams driven by a timing belt, forged crankshaft
112 hp at 6,600 rpm, 97 lb-ft at 4,800 rpm in the US GT-S; 130 PS (128 hp) at 6,600 rpm in Japan
1,587 cc, 81 x 77 mm bore x stroke, 9.4:1 compression
Fuel injection with T-VIS, butterfly valves in the intake runners that open at about 4,200 rpm; airflow meter on US cars, pressure (MAP) sensor in Japan
Toyota’s GR Heritage Parts program has remade some AE86 parts, including new cylinder blocks and heads

issues.x: DSPORT magazine says the 4A-GE’s head gaskets are prone to failure. Goodwood’s buyer’s guide still calls the twin-cam mechanically tough.
Both camshafts are driven by a timing belt. JDM Buy Sell’s buyer’s guide says to ask for dated belt records and to treat the belt as due if there are none.
issues.fix: Replace the timing belt if there are no dated records.

issues.x: Goodwood warns about single-cam AE85s passed off as twin-cam AE86s, especially when bought unseen from an importer. JDM Buy Sell says a 4A-GE fitted to an AE85 does not make it an AE86, so check the chassis code and papers against the engine.

4A-C.name: Toyota 4A-C
facts: 70 hp SAE net at launch, 74 hp from 1986
1,587 cc, 81 x 77 mm bore x stroke, 9.0:1 compression
